governing_directive: We need to have understood everything related to the first model before we increase complexity.

spatial_mesh_anchor.geometry: 1.0 mm x 1.0 mm square domain with 0.5 mm sharp horizontal slit along y=0.5 mm

initial_stiffness_K0.evaluation: Total stiffness variation across 4x time-step ratio is < 0.001%, confirming complete time-step independence in the elastic pre-fracture regime.

peak_force_Fmax.evaluation: Peak load variation across 4x time-step ratio is 0.069% (0.758151 -> 0.757778 -> 0.757626 kN), demonstrating excellent structural limit load convergence.

peak_displacement_u_peak.evaluation: Peak displacement occurs at u = 0.005855-0.005864 mm across all 3 temporal levels (< 0.16% spread).

residual_elastic_energy_Eelas.evaluation: Residual elastic energy drops to < 0.0012 mJ at u = 0.010 mm in all three runs (> 99.95% elastic release upon ligament separation).

external_work_Wext.evaluation: External work displays a smooth, strictly monotonic asymptotic decrease with progressive time-step refinement (-2.11% from T1 to T2, and -1.16% from T2 to T3), reflecting standard temporal integration behavior with diminishing increments.

global_bookkeeping_diagnostic_Delta_book.evaluation: Bookkeeping residual Delta_book = E_model - W_ext is maintained strictly as a descriptive numerical diagnostic across all discretizations. No arbitrary pass/fail threshold is imposed; the residual captures staggered-solver temporal phase lag and numerical quadrature characteristics.

implemented_phase_field_crack_surface_fu.evaluation: The implemented phase-field crack-surface functional SDV17 exhibits modest post-peak sensitivity (-3.93% T3 vs T2), consistent with finer temporal resolution of the rapid damage localization rate during dynamic softening.

claims_discipline_statement: In accordance with rigorous Master thesis claims discipline: (1) Initial stiffness K0, peak reaction force F_max, and displacement at peak u(F_max) are definitively converged and stable (< 0.07% total variation across 4x time-step range); (2) External work W_ext and implemented crack-surface functional E_frac (SDV17) exhibit acknowledged temporal sensitivity; (3) Delta_book is reported as a descriptive diagnostic without arbitrary bookkeeping pass/fail thresholds.
